targetText: The rate of surplus-profit, considering both the additional capital and the total capital invested in the soil, decreases; but the absolute magnitude of the surplus-profit increases; just as the decreasing rate of profit on capital in general is, in the main, accompanied by an increase in the absolute amount of profit.
explanation: The rate of profit ($p/C$) measures surplus value relative to total invested capital (constant plus variable), whereas the rate of surplus value ($s/v$) measures exploitation relative to labor costs alone.
